title: Руководитель казанского сервиса и человек, которого он знает много лет
demonstrates: Slot 22 in writing, at his warmest: half an hour to a first reply, a few words and a question about the customer's father. No time, no price, nothing written down; «принял». Both drafts written over. Nobody resolves it.
